headline: Sensex and Nifty Snap Seven-Day Rally in Red Muhurat Trading Session as Global Cues Drive Market Outlook

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex and Nifty ended the Diwali Muhurat trading session marginally lower, snapping a seven-day winning streak.
This marked the first time since 2017 that Indian benchmark indices closed in the red during Muhurat trading.
Global crude oil prices declined, with Brent falling below $98 after its largest weekly drop since 2020.
Key factors influencing market direction today include GIFT Nifty cues, US nonfarm payrolls data, and Asian market trends.
whatHappening: BSE and NSE conducted the special Diwali Muhurat trading session.
Indian equities had recorded their best weekly performance in six years ahead of the Diwali session.
Asian markets showed mixed trends, with Kospi dropping due to tech sector weight while Nikkei rebounded.
The US dollar retained gains following the release of nonfarm payrolls data.
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty paused their seven-day rally after closing slightly lower in the Diwali Muhurat session. This was the first red Muhurat trading close for the market since 2017, following a strong weekly performance. Investors today are tracking GIFT Nifty, US payrolls data, and lower oil prices for market direction.
